lessons.name: Read vowel team stories: ai, ay

textContent.text: May stands in her playroom. "I want to paint, but what if it looks plain?" She calls Mr. Hays. "Can I pay you to paint?"
Soon, Mr. Hays comes. May claps, "I can't wait to see what you make!"
He lifts pails of paint from his van. He adds gray paint to a tray. Then he rolls the paint on the wall.
At the end of the day, May beams.
"No way! I love the gray ape," she says. "Thank you, Mr. Hays!"

content.text: Where does Mr. Hays first put the gray paint?

contents.text: Sometimes two vowels work together as a vowel team. The first vowel in a vowel team says its name. It makes a long vowel sound. The second vowel is silent.
The vowel team ai makes the long a sound /ā/.
The letter Y can sometimes act as a vowel. So the vowel team ay makes the long a sound /ā/.
